value.rationale: Quadratic-residue translates form a canonical finite-field pseudorandom concept system. The first nonprime extension at 49 points beyond the published 25-point classification has only 4704 shattered five-sets, splitting into exactly two full free symmetry orbits, while 188160 four-sets are maximal. Exact face/orbit/extension structure informs covering-array, incidence and learning complexity questions and is not supplied by VCdim alone.
